welcome_desc: A home for every Godot project and engine version on this machine. Let's set a few things up so it works the way you want, it only takes a minute, and everything here can be changed later in Settings.
onboard_empty_projects: No folders added yet, GodotHub won't find any existing projects until you add one, or you can add projects manually later.
onboard_empty_versions: No folders added yet, new Godot downloads will go to the app data folder unless you set one below.
onboard_no_template_folder: No folder set, you can always configure this later in Settings, or save templates manually.
onboard_categories_desc: Nothing here is required, projects with no category simply show up as Uncategorized.
onboard_cloud_desc: Already have a backup? Sign in with GitHub and restore your workspaces, projects, and settings from a gist.
